name: print-social-pixel-sticker-easter-carousel-cover
title: Pastel Easter cover with pixel-art stickers and pill labels
whatItIs: A 4:5 portrait cover on flat powder blue. A cut-out photo of a woman in a big-collar dress stands centre. Chunky blue rounded display type says EASTER at the top. Pixel-art eggs, a bunny, bow and cake float around her. Three mustard pill-shaped labels with dark outlines carry short phrases, and a fuzzy pink bunny toy peeks from the corner.
whatItMeans: Cute, playful and seasonal: it feels like a game or a Tamagotchi mixed with a real person, warm and youthful without being childish.
techniques: Mix retro pixel-art icons with a real cut-out photo so digital nostalgia meets human warmth.
Use fat rounded display lettering in one saturated blue for a friendly, toy-like voice.
Turn text into pill-shaped buttons with thick dark outlines that read as UI chips or stickers.
Keep the palette to powder blue, mustard, violet-blue and pink, all soft and matte.
Scatter small icons symmetrically around the subject to frame her without crowding.
bestFor: Seasonal social campaigns and holiday carousels
Education, language and lifestyle creators with young audiences
Posters and event flyers with a playful gaming twist

vocabulary.definition: A small illustration drawn on a visible pixel grid, evoking early games.
A rounded capsule shape holding short text, like a button or sticker.
Fat rounded letterforms with a soft, inflated look.
A photo with its background removed to sit on a flat colour.
